notes: Triage hint CONFIRMED. 'This study was a multicentre, single-blind, parallel-group cluster randomised controlled trial' of 20 EIP teams at five UK NHS sites, 1027 patients. The manifest note is also confirmed in both its parts: the trial IS cluster randomised, and employment appears only as an adjusted mean number of days in a multiply-imputed consenting subsample of 232.

Triage hint CONFIRMED as a cohort identification: 'Nationwide cohort study including all individuals (n = 2,390,127) born in Denmark between 1955 and 1991, who were alive at their 25th birthday', with 9448 diagnosed with schizophrenia between ages 15 and 25. The supplement claim in the manifest note is REFUTED as a statement about the held evidence: the Online Appendix is not in the PDF. See manifest_changes.csv.

Triage hint fi_registers CONFIRMED as Finnish national registers but REFINED into two cohort_ids. This row carries the schizophrenia case group (6,939), which is a complete national ascertainment of first hospitalisations for ICD-10 F20 in Finland 1988-2015 with its own separately drawn matched control group. See manifest_changes.csv for the reasoning and for why the split changes nothing about pool eligibility.

The other nonaffective psychosis case group (34,565), ascertained by the same operation on a disjoint set of ICD-10 codes (F22-F29) and mutually exclusive with fi_registers_scz by the authors' own rule. The third case group, bipolar disorder (9,047), is NOT given a cohort row: F30-F31 is not a qualifying psychosis diagnosis and the group would fail SAP section 7 outright. Its printed year-0 employment figure, 43% (N = 3,875), is therefore recorded nowhere; it is noted here so that its omission is visible rather than silent.

Triage hint CONFIRMED, with the age range confirmed too: '360 adults experiencing FEP were consecutively recruited from June 2009 to August 2011 as part of a 4-year randomized controlled trial under the Jockey Club Early Psychosis (JCEP) project in Hong Kong', 'the JCEP project was designed to include individuals aged 26-55 years'. relationship = secondary_analysis rather than describes: this is a financial-deprivation analysis of a subset of a trial cohort reported in full elsewhere (Hui et al. Psychol Med 2023;53:2339-2351, the report's reference 28).

Triage hint CONFIRMED in all three parts. Monocentre RCT at Klinikum am Urban Berlin (DRKS00018107); the outcome is a composite EET; the work-motivation selection is real and is coded `selected`; and the counts 36/46 versus 24/44 are printed verbatim in Results 3.2.

Triage hint CONFIRMED, and the batch question answered: the early-stage and later-stage groups are ONE recruited cohort, not two. All 551 were recruited through the same three sources into one catchment-area sample, 2 were excluded for incomplete data, and the 549 were then split post hoc on the number of past psychotic relapses ('Analyses were stratified by the number of previous psychotic relapse'). They therefore take subgroup arms of one cohort_id, not two cohort_ids (D12.5, which reserves separate cohorts for independently recruited samples with prospectively applied mutually exclusive entry definitions).
